schema.title: Response Analyze Internal V1 Analyze Post

CompanyContextPrepareRequest.title: CompanyContextPrepareRequest
CompanyContextPrepareRequest.description: Typed internal API input. Core must authenticate tenant_id before use.

CompanyContextProposal.title: CompanyContextProposal
CompanyContextProposal.description: A proposed projection only; Core remains the profile owner.

DependencyEdge.title: DependencyEdge
DependencyEdge.description: One asserted business dependency; edges require traceable evidence and time bounds.

ImpactSelection.title: ImpactSelection
ImpactSelection.description: Heuristic queue-prioritization record, not a semantic impact conclusion.

JSONAdapterMapping.title: JSONAdapterMapping
JSONAdapterMapping.description: Declarative dot-path mapping only; never a URL, expression, or executable adapter.

PaymentObservation.title: PaymentObservation
PaymentObservation.description: Raw payment aggregate; it makes no commercial relationship assertion.

PeriodObservation.title: PeriodObservation
PeriodObservation.description: A provided numeric observation or revision. No value is inferred from event text.

PublishedAssessment.title: PublishedAssessment
PublishedAssessment.description: Core acknowledgement that a particular assessment signature was published.

SourcePolicySnapshot.title: SourcePolicySnapshot
SourcePolicySnapshot.description: Effective tenant policy version issued by Core for a single job.

SourceProbeRequest.title: SourceProbeRequest
SourceProbeRequest.description: One-shot Core grant to inspect a candidate URL; it never creates a source.
